versions.changelog: 补充 ClawHub publish 兼容坑排查：SKILL.md required / acceptLicenseTerms invalid value，增加手工 API 发布兜底与 metadata mismatch 修复流程。
Remove machine-specific paths from description, drop unsafe troubleshooting steps, mark workspace sync as a sensitive explicit action, and add these checks to the review checklist.
Require checking references/clawhub-review-checklist.md before every skill publish, and include the checklist as part of the skill package.
Add Git/GitHub CLI install checks, GitHub auth, git identity, remote setup, and failure troubleshooting to the skill publishing workflow.
Require a matching GitHub Release every time a skill under ~/Skills is published to ClawHub.
发布流程新增第5步：发布后必须同步 SKILL.md 到 agent 工作空间
新增发布顺序章节：明确 4 步发布流程顺序（版本号 → CHANGELOG → GitHub Release → ClawHub）

- Initial release of marila-skill-publish.
- 提供详细的 ClawHub 技能发布流程与经验，包括必需文件结构与元数据规范。
- 总结常见发布与审核问题，并给出解决方案。
- 收录技能版本更新流程与安全注意事项。
- 提供参考链接及最佳实践建议。
